summary: LuxExperience B.V., the German-domiciled luxury e-commerce group formerly known as MYT Netherlands Parent B.V., furnished a Form 6-K on September 25, 2026, announcing its annual general meeting for November 5, 2026, and attaching its Dutch statutory annual report for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026, the convening notice, agenda, and proxy form. KPMG Accountants N.V. issued the auditor's report dated September 18, 2026. No special-situation transaction, stake, price, or premium is disclosed. Watch for routine AGM voting outcomes and governance items.
